summary: Record payment and validate vehicle exit
user_story: As a driver, I want to pay for parking and leave the lot so that my parking session is completed.
description: Record a successful cash or card payment, mark the ticket PAID, permit exit for fifteen minutes, and close the ticket when the gate validates it.
acceptance_criteria: Payment records contain ticket ID, exact amount, method, time, and unique reference.
Successful payment changes OPEN to PAID exactly once.
A PAID ticket can exit within fifteen minutes.
Successful exit changes PAID to CLOSED and decrements occupancy exactly once.
Duplicate payment and exit requests are idempotent.
